title: Jude and the Harvest
author: E. M. Montrose
blurb: Casper Marchetti, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
